why: The KVEC stack is a named micro-credential programme designed for rural Kentucky educators, not a general instructional element or merely a platform.
This is a named dataset of vocabulary assessment items and model-derived difficulty scores, not a reusable instructional element.
name: British Council Knowledge-based Vocabulary Lists (KVL) difficulty dataset
product_description: A dataset developed from the British Council's Knowledge-based Vocabulary Lists containing productive English-vocabulary test items and GLMM-based difficulty scores for Chinese, German, and Spanish learners of English.
